description: This file defines the LinkManager class, which manages serial and TCP connections, handles threading for communication, and maintains the engine state. It provides mechanisms for establishing connections, sending commands, and logging, specifically within a hardware communication context.

classes.name: LinkManager
classes.description: Manages hardware communication sessions over serial or TCP, handles threading and connection states.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a specified port and waits for confirmation or timeout.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the connection based on port type, setting up connectors accordingly.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the connection using the current connector with a provided listener.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command string through the connector, optionally firing an event.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpacks a received packet via the connector.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Checks if the connector has encountered an error.

methods.name: unpackConfirmation
methods.description: Processes confirmation messages starting with a specific prefix.

methods.name: getDefaultPort
methods.description: Returns the default serial port available, typically the last listed port.
